question: How many sides does a triangle have? 🔺
explanation: Great job! A triangle always has exactly three straight sides! 🔺
hint: Think of a slice of pizza.

question: How many corners does a square have? 🟦
explanation: Awesome! A square has four corners where the sides meet! 🟦

question: Which shape is perfectly round? 🔴
explanation: Super! A circle is perfectly round like a coin! 🔴

question: What shape is a standard door? 🚪
explanation: Great job! A door is tall and looks like a rectangle! 🚪
hint: Two sides are long, two are short.

question: How many sides does a circle have? ⭕
explanation: Awesome! A circle has zero straight sides because it is curved! ⭕

question: What do we call a 3D box shape? 📦
explanation: Super! A box is called a cuboid and has flat faces! 📦

question: What shape is a dice? 🎲
explanation: Great job! A dice is a cube with six square faces! 🎲

question: Which shape looks like a ball? ⚽
explanation: Awesome! A ball is a round 3D shape called a sphere! ⚽

question: What shape is an ice cream cone? 🍦
explanation: Super! It is wide at the top and pointy at the bottom, just like a cone! 🍦
hint: The name is a big clue!

question: What shape is a soda can? 🥫
explanation: Great job! A can is a cylinder with round edges and flat ends! 🥫

question: What shape is a yummy pizza slice? 🍕
explanation: Awesome! A pizza slice has three sides, so it is a triangle! 🍕

question: What shape is a one rupee coin? 🪙
explanation: Super! Coins are flat and perfectly round circles! 🪙

question: Are the sides of a square equal? 🟦
explanation: Great job! A true square has four perfectly equal sides! 🟦

question: What shape is an egg? 🥚
explanation: Awesome! An egg is shaped like a stretched circle called an oval! 🥚
hint: It is not a perfect circle.

question: What shape can roll easily? 🏀
explanation: Super! A round ball (sphere) rolls very smoothly on the floor! 🏀

question: What shape can slide easily? 📖
explanation: Great job! Objects with flat faces like a book can slide nicely! 📖
hint: Think of pushing it on a table.

question: What is a Tangram? 🧩
explanation: Awesome! A tangram is a fun old puzzle made of flat shapes! 🧩

question: How many corners does a rectangle have? 🟩
explanation: Super! Just like a square, a rectangle has four corners! 🟩
hint: Count the corners on a door.

question: What do we make when we fit tiles together? 🧱
explanation: Great job! Fitting tiles without gaps makes a beautiful pattern! 🧱

question: Which shapes tile a floor without gaps? 🟦
explanation: Awesome! Squares have straight sides that fit perfectly next to each other! 🟦

question: Can circles tile a floor without gaps? 🔴
explanation: Super! Because they are round, circles leave little empty gaps between them! 🔴

question: What shape is a car wheel? 🛞
explanation: Great job! Wheels are circles so they can roll very fast! 🛞

question: How many flat faces does a dice have? 🎲
explanation: Awesome! A dice has numbers from 1 to 6 on its six flat faces! 🎲

question: What shape is the sun? ☀️
explanation: Super! We draw the sun as a big, bright circle in the sky! ☀️

question: What shape has exactly 5 straight sides? ⬟
explanation: Great job! A shape with five sides is called a pentagon! ⬟

question: What is the next shape? Circle, Square, Circle... ❓
explanation: Awesome! In this pattern, a square always comes after a circle! 🟦

question: What shape is a flying kite? 🪁
explanation: Super! A standard kite looks like a diamond shape flying high! 🪁

question: Are opposite sides of a rectangle equal? 🟩
explanation: Great job! A rectangle has equal top/bottom and equal left/right sides! 🟩

question: What shape is a birthday party hat? 🥳
explanation: Awesome! A party hat is a tall cone shape! 🥳

question: Can a cylinder both roll and slide? 🥫
explanation: Super! A cylinder can slide on its flat ends and roll on its curved side! 🥫
hint: Think of moving a soda can.

question: What shape is a matchbox? 🧱
explanation: Great job! A matchbox is a 3D rectangle shape called a cuboid! 🧱
hint: It looks like a small brick.

question: What shape is a full moon? 🌕
explanation: Awesome! A full moon shines like a perfect circle in the sky! 🌕

question: What shapes make up a simple 5-piece Tangram? 🧩
explanation: Super! Tangrams are made of cool triangles and a square! 🧩

question: What shape is the flat top of a drum? 🥁
explanation: Great job! The top where we hit the drum is a round circle! 🥁

question: What shape is a thick flat book? 📘
explanation: Awesome! A thick book has length, width, and height, making it a cuboid! 📘
hint: It looks like a flat box.

question: How many corners does a sphere have? ⚽
explanation: Super! A sphere is completely round with absolutely no corners! ⚽

question: What shape is a sandwich cut in half? 🥪
explanation: Great job! Cutting a square sandwich corner-to-corner makes two triangles! 🥪

question: What is the next shape? Triangle, Square, Triangle... ❓
explanation: Awesome! The pattern repeats, so a square comes next! 🟦

question: What shape is a carrot? 🥕
explanation: Super! A carrot is thick at top and pointy at the end, like a cone! 🥕

question: What shape is a water pipe? 🚰
explanation: Great job! A long, round pipe is a hollow cylinder shape! 🚰

question: What flat shape is the face of a clock usually? 🕐
explanation: Awesome! Most wall clocks have a round circle face! 🕐
hint: The hands go round and round.

question: What shape is a mobile phone screen? 📱
explanation: Super! A phone screen is a long shape called a rectangle! 📱
hint: It is taller than it is wide.

question: What shape has exactly six sides? ⬡
explanation: Great job! A hexagon is a cool shape with six straight sides! ⬡

question: What shape is an unsharpened pencil? ✏️
explanation: Awesome! A long, round pencil acts just like a cylinder! ✏️
hint: It can roll on the desk.

question: What shape is a chessboard? 🏁
explanation: Super! A chessboard is a big square made of many tiny squares! 🏁

question: What shape do we see twinkling in the night sky? ✨
explanation: Great job! We draw beautiful stars with five or more pointy corners! ✨

question: How many corners does a triangle have? 🔺
explanation: Awesome! A triangle has exactly three pointy corners! 🔺

question: What shape is an orange? 🍊
explanation: Super! A juicy orange is a round 3D shape called a sphere! 🍊

question: What flat shapes make a star? ⭐
explanation: Great job! The points of a star look just like little triangles! ⭐

question: Learning about shapes makes us... 🧠
explanation: Awesome! Playing and learning with shapes makes your brain very strong and smart! 🧠
